newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian insurance firms in merger agreement.
newsitem.headline: Colombian insurance firms in merger agreement.

text.p: Colombia's top insurance company announced plans Tuesday to consolidate its leadership position by merging with the country's third-biggest insurer.
Compania Colombiana de Seguros, popularly known as Colseguros SA, will merge with La Nacional Compania de Seguros by Dec. 31, Colseguros president Bernardo Botero told Reuters.
"We have a high percentage of common stockholders and they are interested in seeing a more solid and better structured organization," Botero said in a telephone interview.
"With a more solid, better structured and larger organization, we'll be in a better position to compete more efficiently," he said.
Colseguros and La Nacional both belong to the economic group headed by Julio Mario Santo Domingo, one of Colombia's wealthiest financiers.
Botero said Colseguros, the country's oldest insurance company, was already the biggest in Colombia in terms of the sheer number of policies it has unwritten.
Those policies are valued at about $400 million, out of a nationwide total of $1.3 billion divided among 34 different companies.
